displayIdentity.body: Paul completes the journey and sets out again. Paul, having stayed after this many more days, took his leave of the brothers, and sailed from there for Syria, together with Priscilla and Aquila. He shaved his head in Cenchreae, for he had a vow. Having spent some time there, he departed and went through the region of Galatia and Phrygia, in order, establishing all the disciples.
